# MediChoice Dual-Release Two Button/Folding Walker, Height Adjustable with 5 Inch Wheels, Aluminum, Heavy Duty Bariatric 600 lbs Capacity (1 Each)
Brand: MediChoice
Category: Walkers, Rollators & Accessories > Standard Walkers

## Features
DURABLE The durable, 1 inch anodized aluminum tubing provides maximum strength while remaining lightweight. Has a weight capacity of up to 600 pounds.; STREAMLINED DESIGN Each walker has a specialized design that provides more width and depth for bariatric patients. The dual-release folding mechanism allows the frame to be folded easily and makes it ideal for users with limited dexterity.; ADDED COMFORT The contoured/textured handgrips provide additional comfort and security to the user.; ADJUSTABLE The raised H-frame makes for easy over-toilet positioning. Walkers are height adjustable from 31 to 38 inches.

## Specifications
Product Dimensions: 28 x 3 x 35.5 inches; 10.5 Pounds; Date First Available: August 31, 2016

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 81.99 USD.
Rated 4.1 from 38 reviews.
Top review: I'm tall adjusted the height and it fits perfectly, nice not to bend at the waist.FYI, Im 6-2". its also very sturdy. Its also wider, which is tremendous for I have a very wide gait.another reason I got this particular model is it's 600 lb rating. FYI, I weigh 380 lbs. Like I said it's very sturdy at that height. Front dual wheels are your typical wakler wheels. I would like to be larger, to handle grass and cracks in the pavement. They do not swivel either. You have to get use to it. Pick it up when you walk. HTH

## Description
MOVE FREELY & MAINTAIN STABILITY, WHILE REMAINING INDEPENDENT: When you need a durable and stable walker, MediChoice's Bariatric Dual Release Folding Walkers have just what you need. Each walker is made with durable anodized aluminum tubing that's both strong and lightweight. The dual-release mechanism makes folding the walker easy for users with limited dexterity and makes transportation and storage easier. The walker is appropriate for users up to 600 pounds that stand between 5 foot, 4 inches and 6 foot, two inches tall. Precise positioning is possible via the eight adjustment positions, which range from 31 to 38 inches. The 5-inch front wheels make using the walker suitable for both use indoors and outdoors.

#### Directions

To use the walker, first adjust the height and width to fit your needs. To do this, press the dual-release buttons and slide the frame to the desired height and width. Once adjusted, release the buttons to lock the frame in place. Position yourself in front of the walker, with your arms at a 15-45 degree angle to your body, and grip the handles firmly. To walk, lift the walker slightly and take a step forward, then lower the walker and repeat. Always keep your weight on your legs, not on the walker. If you need to rest, use the seat, but be sure to keep your feet on the ground. Always use the brakes when sitting or standing to ensure safety.

## Features

- Quick Fold Design 

Fold the walker flat in seconds for easy storage and transport. Its compact, travel-ready build fits perfectly in car trunks or closets, helping users stay mobile wherever life takes them.
- Reinforced Weight Support 

Crafted with a heavy-duty steel frame, this bariatric walker supports up to 600 lbs with confidence. Ideal for users seeking stability and strength, it ensures secure movement at home or on the go.
- Adjustable Height For Better Posture 

With 10 height settings, the walker customizes to your exact needs for comfort and posture support. It easily locks into place, making it ideal for users from 4’11” to 6’6” who want a tailored walking experience.
- Smooth Rolling Wheels 

Dual front wheels glide effortlessly across both indoor and outdoor surfaces. Combined with non-slip rear tips, they deliver stability, control, and safety for confident walking on any terrain.
- Ergonomic Comfort Frame 

Built for everyday use, the walker’s ergonomic frame and soft-grip handles reduce strain and increase comfort. Perfect for recovery or long-term mobility support, it helps users move naturally and securely.

## FAQ

#### How much weight can this walker support?

The Vive Bariatric Walker is built with a reinforced steel frame that safely supports up to 600 pounds. It’s designed for heavy-duty use while maintaining smooth mobility and dependable stability.

#### Is the walker easy to fold and store?

Yes! The walker features a quick-folding design that collapses flat in just seconds. It easily fits in car trunks, closets, or beside the bed, perfect for use at home, during travel, or for recovery.

#### What is the walker’s height range?

This adjustable walker offers 10 secure height settings to fit users from 4’11” to 6’6”. It locks firmly in place for a custom ergonomic fit that promotes better posture and comfort while walking.

#### Does the walker come with wheels?

Yes, the walker includes dual front wheels for smoother, more controlled movement. The rear legs feature non-slip rubber tips for added traction and safety across indoor and outdoor surfaces.

#### Can the walker be used both indoors and outdoors?

Absolutely. The smooth-rolling dual wheels glide easily over most indoor floors and outdoor pavements. Its stable base and slip-resistant tips provide dependable control wherever you go.

#### How heavy is the walker itself?

Despite its strong steel construction, the walker remains lightweight and easy to handle. It’s designed for effortless lifting, folding, and everyday use without adding strain.

#### Does it come assembled?

The walker arrives partially assembled and takes just a few minutes to set up—no tools required. Clear instructions are included to help you get moving right away.

#### Is the walker comfortable for taller users?

Yes, the adjustable height and extended frame design make it comfortable for users up to 6’6” tall. It provides more walking space and promotes natural movement without hunching or leaning.

#### What warranty does Vive offer?

The Vive Bariatric Walker includes a 2-year warranty on the frame, a 90-day warranty on the wheels, and a 30-day warranty on the tips. You can purchase with complete confidence knowing you’re covered.

#### Who is this walker best suited for?

This heavy-duty folding walker is ideal for individuals who need extra support for mobility, recovery, or balance. Whether you’re regaining strength after surgery or maintaining daily independence, it provides the stability and comfort you can trust.

The bariatric Extra-Wide Two-Button Heavy Duty Walker with Dual 5” Wheels features easy-to-use push-button mechanisms that may be operated by the fingers, the palm, or the side of one’s hand. The front cross braces near the top allow users to maintain a full stride. Each side of this walker operates independently, allowing for easy movement through narrow spaces and greater stability while standing. Sturdy 1” aluminum tubing folds to a slim 4 ½” for easy transportation and storage.

Bariatric Folding Walker

The Bariatric Folding Walker is engineered to deliver exceptional strength, stability, and comfort for larger users who need dependable mobility support. Designed with an extra-wide frame and a high weight capacity of up to 500 or 600 lbs, this heavy-duty walker provides a more comfortable fit while helping users remain active, independent, and confident in their movement.

A two-button folding mechanism allows the walker to fold easily for navigating narrow doorways and tight spaces, making it practical for both home use and travel. The reinforced frame design, featuring a front cross brace and dual side braces, enhances durability and long-term reliability.

Built for everyday use, this bariatric walker combines strength, ease of use, and user-focused design to support safe, stable mobility for bariatric users.

- 500 or 600 lb Weight Capacity – Heavy-duty design provides dependable support for bariatric users
- Extra-Wide Frame – Offers a roomier, more comfortable fit for larger individuals
- Two-Button Folding Mechanism – Folds easily to navigate narrow spaces and doorways
- Reinforced Frame Construction – Front cross brace and dual side braces enhance strength and durability
- Heavy-Duty Stability – Designed for everyday use with reliable balance and support
- Promotes Independence – Helps users stay active, mobile, and confident

This is an excellent product! The HOME DEPOT on-line description of this product and the DRIVE pr...

This is an excellent product! The HOME DEPOT on-line description of this product and the DRIVE product itself are an accurate match! Done carefully, the assembly of the product is understandable and easy with the assembly diagram. (However, I do suggest more literal explanations of the step-by-step instructions for persons with less technically imaginative ability!). The operational procedures are few, easy to understand, and easy to manage. I have had it for about one month; I have used it primarily for travel outside the apartment; The performance of the product has been reliable every time. Purchasers should be aware that this product is a WIDE-BODY product and will require WIDE-ACCESS SPACING to pass through doors and aisles, etc., inside and outside the home. The purchaser should also be aware that the product has a heavy-duty (steel) frame; It has an associated WEIGHT. This can be unmanageable and unsafe for an already weak or disabled user trying to transport it up or down stairs alone, when that is the only available option. ## Features
Allows for 8 height adjustments; Converts heavy-duty walker into wheeled walker; Dual, rubber wheels allow walker to roll easily and smoothly over irregular surfaces; Comes with rear glide caps, and glide covers, allowing use on all surfaces; 500 lb Weight Limit

Product Dimensions: 16 x 5 x 4 inches; 3.8 Pounds; Date First Available: July 12, 2011

Model: 10118CSV

The Drive Medical Bariatric Walker Wheels with Rear Glides comes with 5" caster wheels and two sets of rear glides.
